reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature the goblin can see targets it with an attack, the goblin chooses another goblin with fewer hit dice within 5 feet of it. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

monster.name: Golem, Blood

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The blood golem can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk.
If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

trait.name: Blood Ooze
entries: The blood golem takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the blood golem's Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the blood golem can't be seen and have total cover.

A creature within 5 feet of the blood golem can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 12} Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.
The blood golem can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

trait.name: Blood Sense
entries: The blood golem can magically sense the presence of blood in living creatures up to 1 mile away. It knows the general direction they're in but not their exact locations.

trait.name: Blood Splatter
entries: Any time the golem is hit in combat, a gout of blood erupts from its body. All creatures within 10 feet of the golem must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} until the end of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Split
entries: When a blood golem reaches its maximum hit points for its Hit Dice, it splits into two identical golems. Each golem has hit points equal to half the maximum hit points of the original golem. New golems are one size smaller than the original golem.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes plus 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) necrotic damage, its hit point maximum is reduced by the amount equal to the necrotic damage, and the blood golem regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction in the target's hit point maximum lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The blood golem moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the blood golem enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the blood golem. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the blood golem enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained|PHB}, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the blood golem's turns. When the blood golem moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the blood golem.

monster.name: Golem, Brass

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the brass golem dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Brass Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Cinder Cloud {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem exhales a swirling cloud of smoke and white-hot embers in a 20-foot radius cloud in front of it. The cloud spreads around corners and everything within it is heavily obscured.
The cloud persists for 1 minute or until wind of 10 miles per hour or greater disperses it.

When the cloud appears, each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the cloud's area for the first time or ends its turn there. A creature can only take damage from the cloud once on each of its turns.

action.name: Slow {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Enervating Ray (1/Day)

The target dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

entries: Roll a {@dice d10} and refer to the table below for the color of the gorgimera's dragon head.

trait.name: Gorgon Head
entries: The gorgimera also has a gorgon head with goat horns.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gorgimera doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The gorgimera has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on smell.

entries: If the gorgimera moves at least 20 feet straight towards a creature and then hits with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorgimera makes five melee attacks: two with its claws, two bites (one with each head), and one gore attack (goat horns). Alternatively, it can use its two breath weapons in place of the bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Gore

action.name: Dragon Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon head exhales its breath based on the results from the table above. Each creature in the area affected must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) damage on a failed save, of half as much on a successful one. {@variantrule Damage|PHB} type determined by the table above.

action.name: Gorgon Breath. {@recharge 5}
entries: The gorgon head exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained|PHB}. The {@condition restrained|PHB} target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is {@condition petrified|PHB} until freed by the {@spell greater restoration|PHB} spell or other magic.

entries: On each of his turns, Grawlic can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Grawlic is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Grawlic deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Grawlic that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and Grawlic doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the gremlin has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The fuath gremlin can only breathe underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fuath gremlin makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Dart

action.name: Congeal Water (1/Day)
entries: One creature of the fuath gremlin's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a thick, viscous coating of clinging water-like fluid for 1 minute.
While coated in this substance, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} and must hold its breath to keep from drowning (reference the SRD for Suffocating rules).
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: If {@creature Itara|RA2018} or {@creature Swoana|RA2018} are slain, Grezell goes berserk and gains advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls, but all attack rolls against him have advantage. This effect lasts until he is slain or combat ends.

trait.name: Blood Starvation
entries: Grezell has been imprisoned within this room and his crypt for almost three centuries, deprived of bloody sustenance for the entirety of his imprisonment. His Legendary Resistance and Regeneration traits are limited until he feeds.

trait.name: Bound by Death
entries: The ward placed by Bofred binds Grezell to the immediate vicinity of this room and to his crypt. If his corporeal form is slain, he reappears in a comatose state within his crypt.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Grezell isn't in sunlight or running water, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.

While in bat form, Grezell can't speak, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with him, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

While in mist form, Grezell can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Once Grezell feeds he can then choose to succeed on a saving throw that he has failed.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Grezell regenerates 10 hit points (until he feeds at which point he regenerates 20 hit points) at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Grezell takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Grezell can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Grezell has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Grezell can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: Grezell takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Grezell's heart while he is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in his resting place, Grezell is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: Grezell takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Grezell makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: +1 Longsword (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage or 12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of Grezell's next turn.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by Grezell, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Grezell regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Grezell's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Grezell targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Grezell, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed|PHB} by it. The {@condition charmed|PHB} target regards Grezell as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Grezell's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Grezell's bite attack. Each time Grezell or his companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Grezell is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: Grezell magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Grezell can call {@dice 3d6} wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as Grezell's allies and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Grezell dies, or until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Grezell moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Longsword
entries: Grezell makes one greatsword attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Grezell makes one bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The grig fiddler's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells innately, without requiring material components.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The grig fiddler is a 5th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following bard spells.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the grig surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fiddle {@recharge 5}
entries: The grig begins playing with its legs in a lively tune. Creatures within 30 feet that can hear the grig must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition charmed|PHB} for 1 minute. While {@condition charmed|PHB} by the grig, it uses its action to dance in place, capering comically. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the saving throw is successful, or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to that grig's Fiddle ability for 24 hours.

If the saving throw is successful, or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to that grig's Fiddle ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Deadeye
entries: As a bonus action, Grimb can add {@dice 1d6} to his next attack or damage roll with a longbow or shortbow.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Grimb has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grimb makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Silvered Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: +1 Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature Grimb can see targets him with an attack, Grimb chooses another goblin with fewer hit dice within 5 feet of it. The two swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The jester's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells requiring no components:

trait.name: Last Laugh
entries: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester is brought back after {@dice 1d20} days in a place of the god's choosing.

trait.name: Mock the Dying
entries: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the jester have disadvantage.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Joker's Shuffle {@recharge}
entries: The jester forces one Medium or Small humanoid within 60 feet to make a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the jester and the target exchange locations via teleportation and an illusion causes them to swap appearance: the jester looks and sounds like the target, and the target looks and sounds like the jester. The illusion lasts for 1 hour unless it is dismissed earlier by the jester as a bonus action, or dispelled ({@dc 17}).

action.name: Killing Joke {@recharge}
entries: The jester performs an ancient, nihilistic joke of necromantic power. This joke has no effect on undead or constructs. All other creatures within 60 feet of the jester must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail fall {@condition prone|PHB} in a fit of deadly laughter. The laughter lasts {@dice 1d4} rounds, during which time the victim is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and unable to stand up from {@condition prone|PHB}. At the end of its turn each round, an {@condition incapacitated|PHB} victim must make a successful {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points. The laughter can be ended early by rendering the victim {@condition unconscious|PHB} or with greater restoration or comparable magic.

reaction.name: Ridicule Hope {@recharge 4}
entries: When a spell that restores hit points is cast within 60 feet of the jester, the jester can cause that spell to inflict damage instead of curing it. The damage equals the hit points the spell would have cured and is necrotic.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The guardian cimota's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). The cimota can innately cast the following spells without the need for material components: at will: darkness, blur, plane shift

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The guardian cimota has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian cimota makes two attacks with its scimitar.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Gudmund is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: Gudmund gains 15 temporary hit points when he reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of Gudmund's turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, the priest can cause the attack to deal an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: +2 Unholy Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under Gudmund's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Gudmund can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.

trait.name: Towering Strength
entries: A gug can lift items up to 4,000 pounds as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gug makes two slam attacks, two stomp attacks, or one of each.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice in the same turn, the target must make a successful {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion|PHB}.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The gug moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The gug makes one slam or stomp attack.

legendary.name: Grab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 17}).

legendary.name: Swallow
entries: The gug swallows one creature it has {@condition grappled|PHB}. The creature takes 26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage immediately plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A swallowed creature is no longer {@condition grappled|PHB} but is {@condition blinded|PHB} and {@condition restrained|PHB}, and has total cover against attacks and other effects from outside the gug. If the gug takes 75 points of damage in a single turn, the swallowed creature is expelled and falls {@condition prone|PHB} next to the gug. When the gug dies, a swallowed creature can crawl from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone|PHB}.

legendary.name: Throw
entries: The gug throws one creature it has {@condition grappled|PHB}. The creature is thrown a distance of {@dice 2d4} times 10 feet in the direction the gug chooses, and takes 20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage (plus falling damage if they are thrown into a chasm or off a cliff). A gug can throw a creature up to Large size. Small creatures are thrown twice as far, but the damage is the same.

trait.name: All-Around Vision
entries: Gundar's eye stalks allows it to see in all directions at once. It cannot be {@status surprised|PHB}.

trait.name: Stun Cone
entries: Gundar's central eye produces a cone extending straight ahead from its front to a range of 30 feet. At the start of each of its turns, the eye of the deep decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. All creatures in this area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: Gundar doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Gundar can breathe both air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gundar makes three attacks: two with its pincers and one with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Pincers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. The target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 17}) if Gundar isn't already grappling a creature, and the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} until the grapple ends.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: Each of Gundar's two eye stalks can produce a magical ray once per round. The creature can aim both of its eye rays in any direction and they have a range of 150 feet.

Enfeeblement Ray Using its right eye, the eye of the deep unleashes a powerful ray of enfeeblement. The target must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or deal half damage with all attacks that use Strength for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Major Image
entries: The eye of the deep concentrates its eye rays together to project a major image illusion. The illusion is generated at any point within range and in the eye of the deep's line of sight.

action.name: Paralytic Ray
entries: Using its left eye, the eye of the deep unleashes a powerful paralytic beam. The target must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, Harmek can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a creature he hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of Harmek that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Blinded by Silence
entries: The effects of a silence spell render the headless horror effectively blind. The headless horror automatically fails any ability check that requires the hearing. Attack rolls against the headless horror have advantage, and the headless horror attacks with disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The headless horror makes three attacks: one with its bite and two slam attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: A herald of darkness can destroy any wooden, leather, copper, iron, or paper object by touching it as a bonus action. A mundane item is destroyed automatically; a magical item survives if its owner makes a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw.

trait.name: Gift of Darkness
entries: Aherald of darkness can transform any fey, human, or goblin into one of the shadow fey, if the target willingly accepts this transformation.

trait.name: Shadow Form
entries: A herald of darkness can become incorporeal as a shadow as a bonus action. In this form, it has a fly speed of 10 feet, it can enter and occupy spaces occupied by other creatures, it gains resistance to all nonmagical damage, it has advantage on physical saving throws, it can pass through any gap or opening, and it can't attack, interact with physical objects, or speak. It can return to its corporeal form as a bonus action

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald of darkness uses Majesty of the Abyss, if it is available, and makes one melee attack.

action.name: Embrace Darkness
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d12}) necrotic damage and targets are {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the start of the herald's next turn. Succeeding on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw negates the paralysis.

action.name: Majesty of the Abyss {@recharge 4}
entries: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. All creatures within 30 feet and in direct line of sight of the herald take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) necrotic damage and must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. Those who fail the saving throw are {@condition blinded|PHB} for 2 rounds; those who succeed are {@condition frightened|PHB} for 2 rounds.

action.name: Shadow Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) slashing damage.
The Herald of Darkness can be found in Tome of Beasts by Kobold Press.

trait.name: Second Wind (2/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Herzord can regain 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Herzord adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin captain makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The hobgoblin captain adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the hobgoblin elite guard can deal an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

trait.name: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: As a bonus action, the hobgoblin elite guard can regain 20 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin elite guard makes three melee attacks: two with its longsword and one shield bash.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The hobgoblin elite guard adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During its first turn, the Executioner has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Executioner scores against a {@status surprised|PHB} creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the Executioner is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the Executioner instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The Executioner deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of one of the Executioner's allies that isn't incapacitated, and the Executioner doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Executioner makes three attacks: two with its rapier and one with its dagger.

action.name: +1 Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: +1 Light Crossbow

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the hobgoblin lieutenant can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin lieutenant makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hobgoblin offering guard is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The hobgoblin offering guard gains 5 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the hobgoblin offering guard's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, the hobgoblin offering guard can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hobgoblin offering guard makes two attacks with its battleaxe.

action.name: Unholy Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d3}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under the hobgoblin offering guard's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The guard can have no more than two shadows under its control at one time.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

action.name: Longsword

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hobgoblin witchdoctor is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). The hobgoblin witchdoctor can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Venomous Hex
entries: As a bonus action, the hobgoblin witchdoctor curses one creature that it can see within 90 feet of it for 1 minute. Until the curse is removed, the hobgoblin witchdoctor deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to the target whenever the hobgoblin hits it with an attack.
If the target drops to 0 hit points before the curse ends, the hobgoblin can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn to curse a new creature.
A remove curse spell will end the curse early.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spew Spiders (Recharges after a short or long rest)
entries: The hobgoblin witchdoctor exhales venomous spiders in a 15-foot cone.

Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spiders die after the resolution of the hobgoblin's turn.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the crazed cannibal hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Insane
entries: The crazed cannibal is immune to all spells and magical effects that impact the mind.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crazed cannibal makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its greatsword.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d3 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw against disease or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) on a failure.
The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

action.name: Rusted Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Deadeye
entries: As a bonus action, the hunter can add {@dice 1d10} to its next attack or damage roll with a longbow or shortbow.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The hunter has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks related to hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter can make two attacks each round with either longbow or longsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The inaed's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The inaed can innately cast the following spells 2/day each, requiring no material components: major image, sleep, suggestion.

trait.name: Book Haunt
entries: An inaed inhabiting a book or other object is entirely impervious to nonmagical melee attacks. The book absorbs the damage instead. If the book is destroyed, the inaed appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet and immediately attempts to enter the nearest book. Entering a book takes {@dice 1d4} rounds. During this time, the creature is visible but still incorporeal. Books that have been freed of any inaed and books that have been sanctified by a cleric are immune to infestation.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The inaed can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object that is not a book.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The inaed has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The inaed magically becomes {@condition invisible|PHB} until it casts a spell or begins entering a book.

monster.name: Intellect Devourer
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

trait.name: Mindsense
entries: The intellect devourer is aware of the presence of creatures within 300 feet of it that have an Intelligence of 3 or higher. It knows the relative distance and direction of each creature, regardless of physical barriers. Creatures under the effects of magic that protects the mind cannot be detected by the intellect devourer.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The intellect devourer makes one attack with its claws and uses Consume Mind.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Consume Mind
entries: The intellect devourer chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, its Intelligence score is reduced to 0. The target is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence (either from completing a long rest or from a lesser restoration spell).

action.name: Body Snatcher
entries: The intellect devourer chooses one {@condition incapacitated|PHB} creature within 5 feet of it and engages it in a contest of Intelligence.

The intellect devourer overpowers the creature's mental defenses if it beats the target on a contested Intelligence check. The intellect devourer magically consumes the creature's brain and teleports into its skull, taking full control of the target's body. While inside the creature's skull, the intellect devourer has total cover against attacks and other effects outside of the host. The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as its comprehension of language, its telepathy, and its traits. Otherwise, it inherits the target's statistics, memories and knowledge, including spells and languages.

If the host body drops to 0 hit points, the intellect devourer must leave the host. It can also be magically forced from the host's body by means of a protection from evil and good spell being cast on the host. If the host's devoured brain is restored (only possibly with a wish spell), the intellect devourer is forced out of the host. The intellect devourer can choose to leave the host at any time by spending 5 feet of its movement and then teleporting to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of the target. Unless its brain is restored within 1 round, the body dies.

monster.name: Iron Cobra

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Find Target
entries: The iron cobra knows the location of a specific target creature as long as that creature is within 1 mile of it. If the creature is moving, it knows the direction of that creature's movement. If the target is beyond this distance, the iron cobra can't locate the target creature.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The iron cobra is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The iron cobra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapon

trait.name: Poison
entries: The iron cobra contains enough venom for three attacks. After that, it does not deal the poison damage listed in its bite attack.

headerEntries: Irtuk's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks). Irtuk can cast the following spells without requiring any material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Irtuk is a 17th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches Irtuk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of him takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Heated Weapons
entries: Any metal melee weapon Irtuk wields deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a hit (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Irtuk makes two attacks: one with its spear and one with its tail.

action.name: +2 Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20 ft./60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) piercing damage, or 21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB}, Irtuk can automatically hit the target with its tail, and Irtuk can't make tail attacks against other targets.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Itara is a 12th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). She can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Berserk
entries: If {@creature Grezell|RA2018} or {@creature Swoana|RA2018} are slain, Itara goes berserk and gains advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls, but all attack rolls against her have advantage. This effect lasts until she is slain or combat ends.

trait.name: Blood Starvation
entries: Itara has been imprisoned within this room and her crypt for almost three centuries, deprived of bloody sustenance for the entirety of her imprisonment. Her Legendary Resistance and Regeneration traits are limited until she feeds.

trait.name: Bound by Death
entries: The ward placed by Bofred binds Itara to the immediate vicinity of this room and to her crypt. If her corporeal form is slain, she reappears in a comatose state within her crypt.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Itara isn't in sunlight or running water, she can use her action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into her true form.

While in bat form, Itara can't speak, her walking speed is 5 feet, and she has a flying speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

While in mist form, Itara can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. She is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and she can't pass through water. She has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage she takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Once Itara feeds she can then choose to succeed on a saving throw that she has failed.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Itara regenerates 10 hit points (until she feeds at which point she regenerates 20 hit points) at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Itara takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Itara can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Itara has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Itara can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: Itara takes 20 acid damage if she ends her turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Itara's heart while she is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in her resting place, she is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: Itara takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Itara makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Silver Dagger (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Itara can grapple the target (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by Itara, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Itara regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Itara's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Itara targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Itara, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed|PHB} by her. The {@condition charmed|PHB} target regards Itara as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Itara's control, it takes Itara's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for her bite attack. Each time Itara or her companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Itara is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: Itara magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, she can call {@dice 3d6} wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as Itara's allies and obeying her spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Itara dies, or until she dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Itara moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Itara makes one silver dagger attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Itara makes one bite attack.

entries: The jackalwere has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the jackalwere reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the jackalwere can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The jackalwere can use its action to polymorph into a specific Medium human or a jackal-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form, which is a jackal. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

action.name: Bite (Jackal or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Battleaxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage, or 7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Sleep Gaze
entries: The jackalwere gazes at one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target succumbs to a magical slumber, falling {@condition unconscious|PHB} for 10 minutes or until someone uses an action to shake the target awake.
A creature that successfully saves against the effect is immune to this jackalwere's gaze for the next 24 hours. Undead and creatures immune to being {@condition charmed|PHB} aren't affected by it.

entries: Jarvik can use his action to polymorph into a rathumanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into his true form, which is humanoid. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form.

headerEntries: The lhaksharut's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells without expending any material components:

trait.name: Elemental Charge
entries: Whenever the lhaksharut makes a weapon attack or uses its Energy Ray ability, it deals additional acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage (included in the attacks below). The lhaksharut makes the choice of the damage type when it makes the attack or uses the ability.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The lhaksharut is immune to any effect that would change its form.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lhaksharut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lhaksharut has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The lhaksharut's weapon attacks are considered magical for the purposes of damage resistance.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The lhaksharut can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The lhaksharut regains 15 hit points at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall

trait.name: Vorpal Weapon
entries: Kazleth wields a vorpal greataxe. If Kazleth rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll, Kazleth severs the creature's head. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 27 ({@damage 6d8}) slashing damage from the hit.

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rotGM. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse|PHB} spell or other magic.

If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare from mummies of all types for the next 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lady Elan is a 14th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Lady Elan wields the magic item {@item staff of the woodlands|DMG}.
The bonuses of this magic item are included in her statistics below.

trait.name: Blinding Beauty
entries: The AC of the Lady Elan includes her Charisma bonus.

trait.name: Land's Stride
entries: Lady Elan does not suffer from nonmagical difficult terrain and can also pass through nonmagical plants without being {@condition slowed|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or similar hazards. She also has advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such as those created by the {@spell entangle|PHB} spell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Lady Elan fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Staff of the Woodlands
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit ({@hit 11} to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage, or 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

action.name: Blinding Flash {@recharge 5}
entries: All creatures that can see Lady Elan within 30 feet of her must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute. At the end of that minute, it can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. On a failed save, the effect is permanent.
A creature can use its reaction to attempt to avert its gaze from Lady Elan's flashing beauty to grant it advantage on the first saving throw.

action.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
entries: Lady Elan magically polymorphs into a beast with a challenge rating of 1 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 7 hours. She can choose whether her equipment falls to the ground, melds with her new form, or is worn by the new form. Lady Elan reverts to her true form if she dies or falls {@condition unconscious|PHB}. Lady Elan can revert to her true form using a bonus action on her turn.

While in a new form, Lady Elan retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks.

action.name: Inspiration (1/Day)
entries: Lady Elan can choose an intelligent creature to inspire and serve as a muse by giving that creature some token of her affection (typically a lock of her hair). For as long as the nymph wishes and as long as the creature carries her's token, the creature adds the Lady Elan's Charisma bonus to its Wisdom saving throws, its Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks, and any Intelligence skill check to craft an object using artisan tools. Lady Elan can end this bonus at any time as a free action, and can only inspire one creature at a time in this manner.

action.name: Stunning Glance
entries: Lady Elan chooses one creature she can see within 30 feet of her to make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition stunned|PHB} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature who succeeds on the saving throw, or if the effect ends on it, is immune to Lady Elan's Stunning Glance for 24 hours.

Doing this does not require {@status concentration|PHB} on her part, and does not require the use of a spell slot. She cannot use this legendary action again if she has any woodland allies remaining.
