headerEntries: Lord Navarre's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells without requiring material components:

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lord Navarre is a 14th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Aura of Hate
entries: Lord Navarre and any fiends or undead creatures of its choice within 30 feet of it can add Lord Navarre's Charisma modifier to saving throws against effects that would turn undead or banish fiends.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Lord Navarre has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapon
entries: Lord Navarre's weapon attacks are considered magical for the purposes of damage resistance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lord Navarre makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: +1 Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Breath of Corruption {@recharge 5}
entries: Lord Navarre releases a 10- foot cone of necrotic breath. Creatures in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage. If a humanoid creature is slain by this damage, it rises as a shadow demon under the command of Lord Navarre. The shadow demon remains enslaved to Lord Navarre until its death and cannot summon demons of its own. Lord Navarre can only have two shadow demons under its command.

action.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
entries: Lord Navarre has a 75 percent chance of summoning 1 glabrezu. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet. It cannot summon further demons and remains for 1 minute, until Lord Navarre is slain, or until the Lord Navarre dismisses it as an action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lorvius is a 19th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: Lorvius gains 20 temporary hit points when a hostile creature that is not undead and is within 30 feet of him is reduced to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of Lorvius's turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Lorvius can cause the attack to deal an extra 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lorvius makes three melee attacks.

action.name: +3 Unholy Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, the creature takes 35 ({@damage 6d8 + 8}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d8}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under Lorvius's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Lorvius can have no more than four shadows under his control at one time.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Lothum can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Lothum deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Lothum that isn't incapacitated and Lothum doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lothum makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature Lothum can see targets it with an attack, Lothum chooses another goblin with fewer hit dice within 5 feet of it. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The lynx has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the lynx moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}. If the target is {@condition prone|PHB}, the lynx can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lynx makes three attacks: one bite attack and two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Magma Form
entries: The magmoid can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the magmoid or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage.

In addition, the magmoid can flow into a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a hostile creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the flames, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Melt Weapons
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the magmoid melts. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative-1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to-5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or other flammable material is melted or burned and is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The magmoid deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The magmoid makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Magma Blast {@recharge}
entries: The magmoid hurls a blast of magma in a 60-foot line that is 5-foot-wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage on a failure and half as much damage on a success. In addition, any creature or a flammable object in the line ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Marthek hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Insane
entries: Marthek is immune to all spells and magical effects that impact the mind.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Marthek can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Marthek makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The human meat puppet makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. The target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 13}) if the meat puppet isn't already grappling another creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} and takes 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh meat puppet makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw against disease or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 13}) and {@condition restrained|PHB} until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: The otyugh slams creatures {@condition grappled|PHB} by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of the otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't {@condition stunned|PHB}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The greater medusa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The greater medusa's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the greater medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw if the medusa isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly {@condition petrified|PHB}. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained|PHB}. The {@condition restrained|PHB} creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming {@condition petrified|PHB} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell greater restoration|PHB} spell or other magic.

Unless {@status surprised|PHB}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the medusa until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the medusa in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.
If the greater medusa sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 ft. of it and in an area of bright light, the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa makes either three melee attacks—one with its snake hair and two with its greatsword—or two ranged attacks with its longbow

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (1/Day)
headerEntries: The mephit can innately cast tar arrow (as acid arrow but with fire damage) (spell save {@dc 10}, {@hit 2} to hit with spell attacks), requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Charisma.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of scalding tar. Each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mephit remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary bubbling puddle of tar.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Tar Breath
entries: The mephit exhales a 15-foot cone of scalding tar. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the creature's next turn. The creature takes half as much damage on a successful save and does not suffer a reduction in speed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mercane has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Innate Spellcasting: The mercane's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). The mercane can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: dimension door, invisibility (self only)
1/day: plane shift

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mercane makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mesifin is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, Mesifin can move up to his speed toward a hostile creature that he can see.

trait.name: Destructive Aura
entries: Mesifin and all allies within 10 feet of him can add his Charisma modifier to weapon damage rolls (included in the damage below).

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of Mesifin's turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, he can cause the attack to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: +1 Unholy Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, Mezuryk has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Mezuryk scores against a {@status surprised|PHB} creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of his turns, Mezuryk can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Mezuryk is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Insane
entries: Marthek is immune to all spells and magical effects that impact the mind.

trait.name: Multiple Personalities
entries: Mezuryk has been broken by the priests of Orcus and has developed multiple personalities. Which personality manifests is situationally dependent and should be determined by the GM.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Mezuryk deals an extra 28 ({@damage 8d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Mezuryk that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and Mezuryk doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mezuryk can make three melee attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d2 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: +1 Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Mhao immediately goes berserk and gains advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls, but all attack rolls against him have advantage.
This effect lasts until Mhao is slain or combat ends.

trait.name: Blood Starvation
entries: Mhao has been imprisoned within this room and his crypt for almost three centuries, deprived of bloody sustenance for the entirety of his imprisonment. His Regeneration trait is limited until he feeds.

trait.name: Bound by Death
entries: The ward placed by Bofred binds Mhao to the immediate vicinity of this room and to his crypt. If his corporeal form is slain, he reappears in a comatose state within his crypt.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Mhao regenerates 5 hit points (until he feeds at which point he regenerates 10 hit points) at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Mhao takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Mhao can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Mhao has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Mhao can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: Mhao takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Mhao's heart while he is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in his resting place, Mhao is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: Mhao takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mhao makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) piercing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) piercing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by Mhao, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Mhao regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The undead mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The undead mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also {@condition grappled|PHB} by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by it.

trait.name: Weeping Discharge
entries: An undead mimic constantly leaks and oozes its foul adhesive in a 20-foot-radius area around its body. The area quickly becomes coated in the fluids and is considered difficult terrain. Undead mimics are not hampered by this secretion (their own or that of another undead mimic). The slimy coating lasts for 1 hour before becoming inert.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Soul Drain
entries: When the undead mimic kills a creature within 5 feet of it, the undead mimic can use a bonus action to devour the soul of that creature unless the creature succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature's soul is devoured, it can only be returned to life by a resurrection, true resurrection, or {@spell wish|PHB} spell. Each time the mimic devours a soul it gains {@dice 1d6} temporary hit points and its Strength score increases by 2. The temporary hit points and Strength last for 1 hour.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the phase minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

trait.name: Ethereal Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the phase minotaur has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised|PHB}.

trait.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: As a bonus action, the phase minotaur can magically shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The phase minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the phase minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phase minotaur makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its gore.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The mirror fiend is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mirror fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The mirror fiend's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Mirror Gaze
entries: If a creature starts its turn by looking into the mirror, that creature must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or be sucked into the dimensional pocket with the mirror fiend. That creature is at disadvantage on its first attack after entering the dimensional pocket. The only way out of this dimensional pocket is to kill the mirror fiend. The victim's body is {@condition immobilized|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} outside of the mirror while its soul is trapped in the dimensional pocket.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mirror fiend makes two melee or ranged attacks.

action.name: Mirrorblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) psychic damage.

action.name: Mirrorbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mite's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 10}, {@hit 2} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Hatred
entries: Mites have advantage on attacks versus dwarves, gnomes, and deep gnomes.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The mite has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Vermin Empathy (1/ day)
entries: The mite can summon a swarm of bats, a swarm of rats, or a swarm of insects once per day. The summoned creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the mite and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the mite dies, or until the mite dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: Create Spawn
entries: Any humanoid creature slain by the mohrg rises as a zombie at the beginning of the mohrg's next turn. If this occurs, the mohrg regains 10 hit points, and the morhg can immediately make one slam attack as a reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mohrg makes two slam attacks, and one attack with its tongue.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} and {@condition restrained|PHB} (escape {@dc 15}), and the morhg can't grapple another creature or use its slam attack.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage, and is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Moigil is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Serpentfriend
entries: Moigil can speak with reptilian animals at will, including various forms of dinosaurs, lizards, and other cold-blooded creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

monster.name: Moon Beast
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak; telepathy 300 ft.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The moon beast's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells innately without requiring material components:

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The flexible, malleable hide of the moon beast allows the creature to add its Constitution modifier to its Armor Class (included above).

trait.name: Compression
entries: The moon beast can move through any space large enough for a Small creature, although it must squeeze to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The moon beast can make two attacks with its claws and four attacks with its tentacles.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, plus the creature must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage. The moon beast regains a number of hit points equal to half the psychic damage dealt by its tentacles.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Morask has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Morask can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Morask deals an extra 17 ({@damage 5d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Morask that isn't incapacitated and Morask doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Morask makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: +1 Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature Morask can see targets it with an attack, Morask chooses another goblin with fewer hit dice within 5 feet of it. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

trait.name: Death Curse
entries: If a mordnaissant dies, it releases a death curse on all creatures within 30 feet of it. Those creatures must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature cannot regain hit points from spending hit dice and it has disadvantage on all saving throws for 24 hours. A remove curse or greater magic is necessary to end this curse early.

trait.name: Shield of Agony
entries: The mordnaissant's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier (included above).

action.name: Lash of Fury
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d8 + 2}) necrotic damage and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose {@dice 1d4} points of Intelligence. The target becomes {@condition incapacitated|PHB} if this reduces its Intelligence to 0. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

action.name: Pain Wail
entries: The mordnaissant releases a wail. Creatures within 20 ft. that can hear the mordnaissant must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target is {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The morlock has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the morlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the morlock moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.
If the target is {@condition prone|PHB}, the morlock can make another bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, the morlock can deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the morlock that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The morlock makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its club.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The greater mummy is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The greater mummy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: The greater mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy's heart.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The greater mummy has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The greater mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and make one attack with its rotting fist.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rotGM.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The greater mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare from mummies of all types for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The greater mummy makes one melee attack or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Blinding Dust
entries: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the greater mummy. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greater mummy utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of the mummy's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greater mummy magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The greater mummy magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy is immune to all damage, and it can't be {@condition grappled|PHB}, {@condition petrified|PHB}, knocked {@condition prone|PHB}, {@condition restrained|PHB}, or {@condition stunned|PHB}.
Equipment worn or carried by the mummy remains in its possession.

monster.name: Mummy, Guardian
languages: the languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian mummy makes three attacks with its khopesh, or two attacks with its khopesh and one rotting fist attack.

action.name: Khopesh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rotGM.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The guardian mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of mummies of all types for the next 24 hours.

monster.name: Mummy of the Deep
languages: the languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy of the deep can innately cast control water 1/day, requiring no material components. Its innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Mummies of the deep can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy of the deep can use its Dreadful Glare and make one attack with its necrotizing strike.

action.name: Necrotizing Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with necrotic fever. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to pluff mud. The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse|PHB} spell or other magic.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The mummy of the deep targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare for all mummies (but no mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Drowning Breath
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The creature is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 13}). If the creature has not broken the mummy's grapple by the start of the mummy's next turn, the mummy of the deep uses its next action to press its lips against the creature's and regurgitates seawater into the creature's lungs. The creature immediately begins suffocating (see the fifth edition SRD for more information on suffocation). While suffocating, the creature can only use its actions to try and cough the seawater up, requiring a successful {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw to do so.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy priest is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The mummy priest of Orcus gains 15 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the mummy priest's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, the mummy priest can cause the attack to deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy priest can use its Dreadful Glare and make one attack with its rotting fist or with its mace.

action.name: Unholy Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rotGM.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: The mummy priest targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the mummy, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare from mummies of all types for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under the mummy priest's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The mummy priest can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
entries: The mu spore ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} or {@condition restrained|PHB}. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being {@condition grappled|PHB}. Being underwater imposes no penalties on the mu spore's movement or attacks.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: Sticky, arm-length tendrils cover the mu spore.

Whenever a creature begins its turn within 5 feet of the mu spore, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 20}). The mu spore has no limit to the number of creatures it can grapple in this fashion and it does not suffer from the {@condition grappled|PHB} condition while grappling other creatures with its grasping tendrils. A tendril can also be attacked and severed (AC 15; hp 10; immunity to acid, poison, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the mu spore fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The mu spore does double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mu spore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tendrils.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by the mu spore, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded|PHB} and {@condition restrained|PHB}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mu spore, and it takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the mu spore's turns. A mu spore can have four creatures swallowed at a time.

If the mu spore takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the mu spore must succeed on a {@dc 28} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone|PHB} in a space within 10 feet of the mu spore. If the mu spore dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained|PHB} by it and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 20}). Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB}. The mu spore has 10 feeder tendrils, each of which can grapple a target.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by the mu spore is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked {@condition prone|PHB}. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}

action.name: Spore Cough {@recharge 5}
entries: The mu spore releases a cloud of burrowing spores in a 120-foot cone. Creatures in the affected area must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 90 ({@damage 20d8}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

legendary.name: Tendril Attack or Fling
entries: The mu spore makes one tendril attack or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Constrict (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: All creatures {@condition grappled|PHB} by the mu spore must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Spore Blast (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The mu spore releases a large blast of spore-laden air from itself in all directions. Creatures within 15 feet of the mu spore that aren't {@condition grappled|PHB} by it must make a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pushed back 15 feet and knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

resist.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Nadroj is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Nadroj can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Nadroj has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Sacrilegious Aura
entries: Nadroj exudes an aura of desecration out to a radius of 30 feet. Nadroj and any undead within the defiled area have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: Nadroj targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under Nadroj's control. Nadroj can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

monster.name: Naughty Trolls, The, Gurang, The Speedy Troll

walk.condition: (60 ft. when using boots of speed)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Gurang can breathe both air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Gurang has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: Gurang's skin contains a powerful poison. Any time the creature touches another creature, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Gurang regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn as long as it is at least partially submerged in water; strong rainfall also allows the troll's regeneration to function. If the troll takes acid, fire, or lightning damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll only dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gurang makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

monster.name: Naughty Trolls, The, Warsach, The Sneaky Troll

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Warsach can breathe both air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Warsach has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: Warsach's skin contains a powerful poison. Any time the creature touches another creature, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Warsach regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn as long as it is at least partially submerged in water; strong rainfall also allows the troll's regeneration to function. If the troll takes acid, fire, or lightning damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll only dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Warsach deals an extra 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Warsach that isn't incapacitated and Warsach doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Warsach makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

monster.name: Naughty Trolls, The, Zoolbing, The Scary Troll

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Zoolbing can breathe both air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: Zoolbing has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Poison Skin
entries: Zoolbing's skin contains a powerful poison. Any time the creature touches another creature, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Zoolbing regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn as long as it is at least partially submerged in water; strong rainfall also allows the troll's regeneration to function. If the troll takes acid, fire, or lightning damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll only dies if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zoolbing makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its gauntlet of rustGM, and one shield bash.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Gauntlet of Rust
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is wearing metal armor (including shield), the armor takes a permanent and cumulative-1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to +0 bonus is destroyed. If the target is wielding a metal weapon and it comes into contact with the gauntlet, the weapon corrodes as described in the Rust Metal trait of the Rust Monster.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d4 + 9}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The neothelid's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells requiring no components:

trait.name: Mindsense
entries: The neothelid is aware of the presence of creatures within 1 mile of it that have an Intelligence of 3 or higher. It knows the distance and direction of each creature, as well as the creature's approximate Intelligence (within 3 points), regardless of physical barriers. Creatures under the effects of magic that protects the mind or protects from divination cannot be detected by the neothelid.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The neothelid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neothelid makes two tentacular tongue attacks.

action.name: Tentacular Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the neothelid. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded|PHB} and {@condition restrained|PHB}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and it takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns.

If the neothelid takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the neothelid must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone|PHB} in a space within 10 feet of the neothelid. If the neothelid dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained|PHB} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Acid Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The neothelid exhales acid in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Consume Mind
entries: The neothelid chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, its Intelligence score is reduced to 0. The target is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence (either from completing a long rest or from a {@spell lesser restoration|PHB} spell).

trait.name: Feed on Fear
entries: The night terror regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and a creature within 30 feet of it has the fear condition.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The night terror can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The night terror sheds dim light in a 5- to 20foot radius.
The night terror can alter the radius as a bonus action.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the night terror has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The night terror can't be affected or detected by spells of 4th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Chill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d6 + 9}) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened|PHB} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The night terror and its light magically become {@condition invisible|PHB} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration|PHB} ends (as if {@status concentration|PHB|concentrating} on a spell).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The nightcrawler's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells without components:

trait.name: Desecrating Aura
entries: Undead within 30 feet of the nightcrawler, including the nightcrawler itself, have advantage on saving throws against turn undead.

trait.name: Light Aversion
entries: If a nightcrawler begins its turn in an area of bright light, it must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the start of its next turn. It makes the saving throw with disadvantage if it is in an area of bright light that counts as sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightcrawler can make one attack with its Bite and one attack with its Sting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 19}). If the target is a Large or smaller creature and is {@condition grappled|PHB} by the nightcrawler's pincers, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded|PHB} and {@condition restrained|PHB}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the nightcrawler, and at the start of each of the nightcrawler's turns, the swallowed creature takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) cold damage and 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage, and it must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its maximum hit points are reduced by the amount of necrotic damage it took.

If the nightcrawler takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the nightcrawler must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone|PHB} in a space within 10 feet of the nightcrawler. If the nightcrawler dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained|PHB} by it and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 minute; on a successful save, there is no further effect. At the beginning of each of its turns while it remains {@condition poisoned|PHB}, it takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage and has its maximum hit points reduced by half the amount of necrotic damage it took that turn. At the end of its turn, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Summon (1/Day)
entries: As an action, the nightcrawler can summon {@dice 1d6} greater shadows. These summoned creatures cannot summon or create further thralls or undead, and disappear after being dropped to 0 hit points, or after 1 minute.

These greater shadows use the statistics of a shadow, save that they have a Challenge Rating of 3 (700 XP), their hit points are 38 ({@dice 7d8 + 7}), their Strength Drain ability has a {@hit 5} to hit and deals 16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) necrotic damage in addition to their normal reduction to the target's Strength score.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The ophidian has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Snake Hands
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

action.name: Blinding Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The ophidian spews forth a 20-foot cone of viscous liquid. All creatures in this area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving or be {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded|PHB} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Oolarg hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Brutal Critical
entries: Oolarg can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: Oolarg can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of his turn, Oolarg can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls that turn but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Oolarg deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Oolarg that isn't incapacitated and Oolarg doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Oolarg makes two attacks with his war pick.

action.name: +1 War Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Redirect Attack
entries: When a creature Oolarg can see targets it with an attack, Oolarg chooses another goblin with fewer hit dice within 5 feet of it. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The crimson jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The crimson jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a crimson jelly that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new jellies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new jelly has hit points equal to half the original jelly's, rounded down. New jellies are one size smaller than the original jelly.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ebon ooze can move through a space as narrow as one inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Negative Energy Affinity
entries: An ebon ooze is healed by negative energy attacks and harmed by positive energy. When an ebon ooze is subjected to necrotic damage, instead of losing hit points, it heals a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt, up to its hit point maximum. Casting a healing spell on the ebon ooze inflicts an amount of damage equal to the number of hit points the spell would have healed.

trait.name: Slimy Doom
entries: A creature that touches the ebon ooze or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature begins to bleed uncontrollably and has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws. In addition, whenever the creature takes damage, it is {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of its next turn. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after three successful saving throws. The disease can also be cured by a {@spell greater restoration|PHB} or {@spell heal|PHB} spell.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the ebon ooze has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be infected with slimy doom.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mustard jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Energy Absorption
entries: A mustard jelly is immune to force and lightning damage. If the jelly would have taken force or lightning damage, it is instead healed for the same amount it would have taken in damage.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The mustard jelly's attacks are magical.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mustard jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Poison Aura
entries: At the start of each of the mustard jelly's turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage. A creature that touches the jelly or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The undead ooze can move through a space as narrow as one inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Ooze Mass
entries: The undead ooze takes up most of its space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the undead ooze's engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the undead ooze can be seen but have total cover.

A creature within 5 feet of the ooze can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the ooze. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.
If a skeleton is pulled out, it animates as if the ooze's skeletons ability was used.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The undead ooze moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creature's spaces. Whenever the ooze enters a creature's space, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the ooze. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the undead ooze enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is {@condition restrained|PHB}, and takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the ooze's turns. When the ooze moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.
An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

action.name: Skeletons
entries: An undead ooze can expel {@dice 1d6} skeletons from its mass, each appearing within 5 feet of the ooze. Skeletons can act in the round they are expelled. Slain skeletons are engulfed by the undead ooze and can be reanimated and expelled again in {@dice 1d2} hours. An undead ooze's form holds up to 10 skeletons of Medium size. They remain active even if the ooze is killed. Some undead oozes have unusual or larger skeletons inside of them.

trait.name: Magic Immunity
entries: The Oracle is immune to all spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The Oracle doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Knowledge (1/Week)
entries: The Oracle can contact a greater power from the Outer Planes as per the {@spell contact other plane|PHB} spell. The Oracle is not subjected to the saving throw to avoid insanity as per the spell.
The Oracle can ask the entity up to five questions. The GM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never,"
"irrelevant," or "unclear." The Oracle is not required to be truthful with the characters when relaying the answers to the questions.

trait.name: Lore Master
entries: The Oracle has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Nature}, and {@skill Religion}) checks.

action.name: Brain Drain
entries: The Oracle targets a single creature that it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or the target's Wisdom is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Wisdom to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

monster.name: Overmind, The
languages: Undercommon but can't speak; telepathy 5 miles

trait.name: Boon of the Overmind
entries: All encephalon gorgers within 120 feet of the Overmind gain a +2 bonus to AC and have advantage on Charisma-based skills and saving throws.

trait.name: Hivemind
entries: The Overmind can maintain telepathic communication with up to 8 creatures at a time. Each of these creatures, through the Overmind, can telepathically communicate with each other.

trait.name: Mindsense
entries: The Overmind is aware of the presence of creatures within 60 feet of it that have an Intelligence of 4 or higher. It knows the precise distance and direction of each creature, as well as the creature's exact Intelligence score. Creatures under the effects of magic that protect the mind cannot be detected by the Overmind.

trait.name: Mind Fortress
entries: The mind of the Overmind is an alien and dangerous place.

Should a creature attempt to scan the mind or read the thoughts of the Overmind (with detect thoughts, telepathy, or the like), it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is under the effects of the {@spell feeblemind|PHB} spell. On a successful save, the creature is under the effect of the {@spell confusion|PHB} spell for 1 minute.

trait.name: Synaptic Aura
entries: Any creature that comes into physical contact with the Overmind takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Mind Blast
entries: The Overmind magically emits psychic energy. All creatures within 20 feet of the Overmind must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned|PHB} for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Steelshod Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Spit Venom. {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute.
The {@condition blinded|PHB} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition blinded|PHB} effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Channel Destruction
entries: Luther deals an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage when it hits with a weapon attack (included in the attacks below).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Luther has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapon
entries: Luther's weapon attacks are considered magical for the purposes of damage resistance.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: In death, Luther's spirit is bound to the armor rather than the physical body. If Luther is dropped to 0 hit points but the armor is not destroyed, the armor will regenerate the body at full hit points over the course of 5 ({@dice 1d10}) days.

trait.name: Sacrilegious Aura
entries: Luther exudes an aura of desecration in a 60- foot radius. Luther and any undead (including Luther) within the defiled area have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Luther makes two melee attacks.

action.name: +2 Frostbrand Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) slashing damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Devastating Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: Luther unleashes a 30-foot cone of violent energy. Creatures in this area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 72 ({@damage 16d8}) necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a successful save.

entries: Pesties have advantage on attacks versus dwarves, gnomes and deep gnomes.

trait.name: Keen Smell

action.name: Shortbow

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Petrus adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Petrus must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The phasma doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The phasma can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the phasma has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phasma makes two phantom touch attacks.

action.name: Phantom Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}41 ({@damage 8d8 + 5}) necrotic damage, and the target's Wisdom score is lowered by {@dice 1d6} and the phasma gains 5 temporary hit points. The target dies if this reduces its Wisdom to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. In addition, the target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target can't take reactions and must roll a {@dice d10} at the start of each of its turns to determine the behavior for that turn.

entries.name: Phantom Touch
rows: The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. The creature doesn't take an action this turn.
The creature doesn't move or take actions this turn.
The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.
The creature can act and move normally.

action.name: Phantasmagoria {@recharge 6}
entries: The phasma taps into the nightmares of each creature it can see that is within 30 feet of it, creating an illusory manifestation of each target's deepest fears, visible only to that creature.

Each creature must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the phasma's Phantasmagoria for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The priest of Orcus gains 15 temporary hit points when he reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the Phesor's turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Phesor can cause the attack to deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: Unholy Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under Phesor's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Phesor can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.
