action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@condition grappled|PHB} by the servitor, {@condition incapacitated|PHB} or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A {@condition paralyzed|PHB} creature can be {@condition grappled|PHB} and controlled by the nearest plantoid.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Plethor is a 15th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: Plethor gains 15 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of Plethor's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, Plethor can cause the attack to deal an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Plethor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: Plethor gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Plethor's heart.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Plethor can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist or with its mace.

action.name: +2 Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rotGM. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse|PHB} spell or other magic.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: Plethor targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see Plethor, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} until the end of Plethor's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare from mummies of all types for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under Plethor's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Plethor can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Plethor makes one melee attack or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Blinding Dust
entries: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around

legendary.name: Plethor
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of Plethor must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Plethor utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of Plethor that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of Plethor's next turn.

legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Plethor magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of Plethor, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Plethor's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Plethor magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, Plethor is immune to all damage, and it can't be {@condition grappled|PHB}, {@condition petrified|PHB}, knocked {@condition prone|PHB}, {@condition restrained|PHB}, or {@condition stunned|PHB}.
Equipment worn or carried by Plethor remains in its possession.

trait.name: Quills
entries: Any creature that makes a melee attack within 5 feet of the giant porcupine must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage. Any creature that attempts to grapple the porcupine takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage when they make the attempt and at the start of each of their turns they maintain the grapple.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant porcupine makes one attack with either its bite or claws, and makes an attack with its Tail Slap.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The priest of Orcus is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The priest of Orcus gains 15 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Deadsight
entries: The most blessed of Orcus are gifted with truesight.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the priest's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, the priest can cause the attack to deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: +1 Unholy Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under the priest's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The priest can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.

headerEntries: The priest of Tsathogga is an 8th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Breath of the Swamp
entries: The blessed of Tsathogga can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Fetid Shroud of the Frog God
entries: The priest of Tsathogga is surrounded by a fetid, swirling shroud of foul corruption. At the start of each of the priest's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.
A creature that touches the priest or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Fetid Strike
entries: Once on each of the priest's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, the priest can cause the attack to deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage to the target.

action.name: +1 Sickle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Plague of Frogs (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The priest magically calls {@dice 1d4 + 3} giant frogs, provided that the priest is within 100 feet of a body of water large enough to cover a Medium creature (GM discretion). The called creatures arrive within {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the priest, and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the priest dies, or until the priest dismisses them as a bonus action.

action.name: Fists of Chaos

action.name: Staff of the Python
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Plague of Frogs (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, Purbok can deal an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage to a creature he hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of Purbok that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Purbok makes two melee attacks.

action.name: +2 Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The pyrohydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The pyrohydra has twelve heads. While it has more than one head, the pyrohydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded|PHB}, {@condition charmed|PHB}, {@condition deafened|PHB}, {@condition frightened|PHB}, {@condition stunned|PHB}, and knocked {@condition unconscious|PHB}.
Whenever the pyrohydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the pyrohydra dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The pyrohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the pyrohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the pyrohydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pyrohydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The pyrohydra exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each head has its own recharge counter.

entries: Quanall has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Greater Ring of Protection
entries: Quanall has a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing the greater ring of protectionGM.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Quanall makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spit Venom {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute.
The {@condition blinded|PHB} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition blinded|PHB} effect on itself on a success.

action.name: +3 Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 80/320ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d6 + 8}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The maharaja rakshasa is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 24}, {@hit 16} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Be Quick or Be Dead
entries: The maharaja rakshasa has advantage on initiative rolls.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The maharaja rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Polyglot
entries: The maharaja rakshasa is fluent in all languages.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes four bite attacks and one greatsword attack.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ravager moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.
If the target is {@condition prone|PHB}, the ravager can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Form-Shifting
entries: The ravager can physically alter its physiology to take on one of the three listed forms: the crawler, the brawler, or the flier.
Doing so takes one minute, and during this period it cannot take any other actions, though it is not considered {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

trait.name: Improved Critical
entries: The ravager's bite and claws score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the ravager fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Disruption
entries: Every time the ravager comes into contact with magical effects, there is a chance that it disrupts it. This effect functions as the {@spell dispel magic|PHB} spell cast using a 7th level spell slot with a +7 spellcasting ability modifier.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The ravager's melee attacks are magical.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the ravager reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the ravager can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

The ravager only dies if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

The spear disappears if it is more than 5 feet away from the priest for 1 minute or more, or if the priest dies. Setiathet can dismiss the spear at will (no action required). This feature cannot be used to summon a new spear while Setiathet already is in possession of a summoned spear.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spear of Darkness
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Touch of the Serpent God (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The shadow hunter hatchling has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow hunter hatchling can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The shadow hunter has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow hunter can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage and 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the creature is {@condition restrained|PHB}, and the shadow hunter can't constrict another target.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow rat can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The shadow rat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow rat can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points except by magical means, the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4} and its hit point maximum decreases by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) every 24 hours. If the target's hit point maximum or Strength score drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The shantak doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Alien Physiology
entries: Shantaks do not require oxygen and are immune to effects that require breathing.

trait.name: Share Defenses
entries: The shantak can extend the benefits of its alien physiology and cold immunity to one creature within 10 feet of it that it can touch. The shantak can activate or deactivate this feature at will; this does not require an action.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: A creature that attempts to grapple the shantak does so with disadvantage.

trait.name: Starflight
entries: The shantak can survive in the vacuum of out space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shantak makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 17}) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The shantak has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sheriff makes three melee attacks: two with its longsword and one with its shortsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The sheriff adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the sheriff must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: For 1 minute, Sheriff Ostland can utter a special command or warning whenever a non-hostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a {@dice d4} to its roll provided it can hear and understand Sheriff Ostland. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Sheriff Ostland is {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) slashing damage, or 6 ({@dice 1d10 + 1}) if used with two hands.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400, one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The shining child's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells without material components:

trait.name: Radiant Armor
entries: The AC of the shining child includes its Charisma bonus.

trait.name: Radiance
entries: The shining child sheds bright light out to 10 feet, and dim light an additional 10 feet. Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in this area automatically fail.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shining child uses its Blinding Light ability and makes one Burning Touch or Searing Ray attack.

action.name: Blinding Light
entries: The shining child shines with blinding light in a 60- foot radius, with an additional 60 feet of dim light beyond. Any creature who can see the shining child must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition blinded|PHB} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If, after one minute, an affected creature has not ended the {@condition blinded|PHB} condition on itself through either succeeding on the saving throw or using magic, it is permanently {@condition blinded|PHB}.

A creature can use its reaction to shield its eyes by making a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. If successful, it is {@condition blinded|PHB} until the start of its next turn, but does not have to make the Constitution saving throw to avoid blindness as above. On a failed Dexterity save, it must immediately make the Constitution saving throw.

action.name: Burning Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) radiant damage plus 19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) fire damage, and target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target begins to radiate, shedding bright light in a 60-foot radius centered on it.

While under this effect, the target automatically fails Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a failure, or ending the effect on itself on a success.
The Burning Touch effect can be extinguished by magical darkness, a greater restoration or {@spell heal|PHB} spell.

action.name: Searing Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120/300 ft., one target. {@h}42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage, or 63 ({@damage 18d6}) radiant damage if the target is undead.

monster.name: Slithering Tracker
languages: understands languages it knew in its previous form

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the slithering tracker has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it {@status surprised|PHB}.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While grappling a creature, the slithering tracker takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature it is grappling takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the slithering tracker remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a puddle, unless an observer succeeds on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.

trait.name: Keen Tracker
entries: The slithering tracker has advantage on Wisdom checks to track prey.

trait.name: Liquid Form
entries: The slithering tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can also move through a space as narrow as l inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The slithering tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Watery Stealth
entries: While underwater, the slithering tracker has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide, and it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Life Leech
entries: One Large or smaller creature that the slithering tracker can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. In addition, the {@condition grappled|PHB} target takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The slithering tracker can grapple only one target at a time.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sigma is a 7th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Breath of the Swamp
entries: Sigma can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Fetid Shroud of the Frog God
entries: Sigma is surrounded by a fetid, swirling shroud of foul corruption. At the start of each of his turns, each creature within 5 feet of him takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage. A creature that touches Sigma or hits him with a melee attack while within 5 feet of him takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Fetid Strike
entries: Once on each of Sigma's turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, he can cause the attack to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to the target.

action.name: +1 Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Plague of Frogs (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Sigma magically calls {@dice 1d4 + 4} giant frogs, provided that he is within 100 feet of a body of water large enough to cover a Medium creature (GM discretion).

The called creatures arrive within {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as his allies, and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until he dies, or until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Simrath isn't in sunlight or running water, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.

While in bat form, Simrath can't speak, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with him but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

While in mist form, Simrath can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Simrath fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When he drops to 0 hit points outside his resting place, Simrath transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition unconscious|PHB}, provided that he isn't in sunlight or running water. If he can't transform, he is destroyed.
While he has 0 hit points in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed.

Once in his resting place, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until he regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Simrath regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Simrath takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Simrath can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Simrath has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Simrath can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: Simrath takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Simrath's heart while he is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in his resting place, Simrath is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: Simrath takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Simrath makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Greatsword (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by Simrath, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Simrath regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Simrath's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Simrath targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Simrath, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed|PHB} by Simrath. The {@condition charmed|PHB} target regards Simrath as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected.

Although the target isn't under Simrath's control, it takes Simrath's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Simrath's bite attack. Each time Simrath or his companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Simrath is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Malevolent Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: Simrath magically calls {@dice 4d4} swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call {@dice 3d6} worgs instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of Simrath and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Simrath dies, or until Simrath dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Simrath moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Greatsword Attack
entries: Simrath makes one greatsword attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Simrath makes one bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sir Kingsly is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Aura of Protection
entries: An aura of protection surrounds Sir Kingsly. Sir Kingsly and his allies within 10 feet of him can add his Charisma bonus to saving throws.

trait.name: Aura of Courage
entries: Sir Kingsly and his allies that are within 10 feet of him cannot be {@condition frightened|PHB}.

trait.name: Divine Health
entries: Sir Kingsly is immune to disease.

trait.name: Divine Sense
entries: Sir Kingsly is aware of the location of any celestial, end, or undead within 60 feet. Within the same radius he can also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated.

trait.name: Divine Strike
entries: Whenever Sir Kingsly hits a creature with a melee attack, the creature takes an extra {@damage 1d8} radiant damage (included in below).

trait.name: Lay on Hands
entries: As an action, Sir Kingsly can touch a creature, healing it for a maximum of 60 hit points. After he has healed a total of 60 hit points, he can't use this ability again until after a short or long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sir Kingsly makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d2 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands, and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The siren 's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells 1/day each, requiring no material components: charm person.fog cloud, greater invisibility, polymorph (self only).

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The siren doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Luring Song
entries: The siren sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the siren that can hear the song must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed|PHB} until the song ends. The siren must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the siren is {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

While {@condition charmed|PHB} by the siren, a target is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and ignores the songs of other sirens. If the {@condition charmed|PHB} target is more than 5 feet away from the siren, the target must move on its turn toward the siren by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the siren, the target can repeat the saving throw. A {@condition charmed|PHB} target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this siren's song for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The siren has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The siren makes two attacks with its talons.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Sister Macry is a 20th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). She can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Diminished Power
entries: Due to the long-term and remote confinement, Sister Macry has lost access to Blessing of Muir, Protective Shroud of Muir, and Blessed Strike, and has no spells prepared. (The information provided below is in case she has a chance to recover her connection with Muir.)

trait.name: Blessing of Muir
entries: Sister Macry is resistant to necrotic damage and immune to the {@condition frightened|PHB} condition.

trait.name: Protective Shroud of Muir
entries: Sister Macry is surrounded by a brilliant aura of radiant energy. At the start of each of her turns, any undead and ends within 20 feet of her takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage. An undead or end that touches Sister Macry or hits her with a melee attack takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked back 10 feet.

trait.name: Blessed Strike
entries: Once on each of Sister Macry's turns when she hits a creature with a weapon attack, she can cause the attack to deal an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage to the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sister Macry makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The slaver is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The slaver gains 15 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the slaver's turns when it hit a creature with a weapon attack, the slaver can cause the attack to deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaver makes three attacks with its ail.

action.name: Unholy Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under the slaver's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The slaver can have no more than four shadows under its control at one time.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Slavish is a 20th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Slavish fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Metamagic Savant
entries: Slavish can twist magic to its needs. Slavish can spend extra spell slots to manipulate the effects of its spells.

trait.name: Heightened Spell
entries: When Slavish casts a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, the lich can spend an extra spell slot of the same level to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

trait.name: Twinned Spell
entries: When Slavish casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, Slavish can spend an extra spell slot of the same level to target a second creature in range with the same spell.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it has a phylactery, Slavish gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: Slavish has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Slavish casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Slavish uses its Paralyzing Touch.

legendary.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Slavish fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened|PHB} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened|PHB} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Slavish's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of Slavish must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Skeleton, Army
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The army skeleton has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The army skeleton makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

monster.name: Skeleton, Black
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Shortsword Masters
entries: Black skeletons gain defensive bonuses (+2 to AC) and bonuses to attack ({@hit 2} to hit) when wielding dual shortswords (included in the statistics).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The black skeleton makes two claw attacks or two shortsword attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}.
The target dies if this reduces its strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The larval slime crawler has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

The target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 11}) if the larval slime crawler isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} until the grapple ends.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The mature slime crawler has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mature slime crawler makes three attacks: two with its tentacles and one with its bite.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 4d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The sepia snake doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the sepia snake's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the sepia snake, the snake can force it to make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw if the sepia snake isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and can see the creature. On a failure, the creature is {@condition frightened|PHB} for 1 minute.

Unless {@status surprised|PHB}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the sepia snake until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the sepia snake in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. While averting its eyes, any attacks on the sepia snake are done at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sepia snake makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail sting.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage. The target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 16}) if the sepia snake isn't already grappling a creature, and the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} until the grapple ends.

action.name: Tail Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) piercing damage and 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage, and the target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving the at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

action.name: Cocoon {@recharge 5}
entries: A sepia snake can fire a line of webbing to a range of 20 feet. Creatures in this area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition restrained|PHB} by webbing. If a creature is completely covered in webbing, it must make a successful {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be placed in a state of magical suspended animation {@dice 1d4 + 12} days. During this time, the creature does not need food or water.

In one round, the sepia snake can spit enough webbing to cover one Medium or smaller creature. For each size category larger than Medium, the snake must fire another line of webbing to completely encase an opponent.

As an action, creatures hit by the webbing but not completely covered can make a {@dc 16} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. A creature that is completely wrapped in the webbing cannot break free and must rely on others to remove the webs. The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 10; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Slow Fall
entries: Socrates reduces any falling damage by 30. If he does not take damage from a fall, he does not drop {@condition prone|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Socrates can make three attacks with his unarmed strike.
He can use his Flurry of Blows or Stunning Strike ability in place of one of the unarmed strikes.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Flurry of Blows (3/Day)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of its choice:

items.name: Prone
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone|PHB}.

items.name: Pushed
entries: The target must make a successful {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from Socrates.

items.name: Agog
entries: The target can't take reactions until the end of the Socrates's next turn.

action.name: Stunning Strike (3/Day)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of the Socrates's next turn.

reaction.name: Deflect Missiles
entries: If Socrates has one hand free, he can use his reaction in response to being hit with a ranged weapon attack. Socrates reduces the damage by 14 ({@dice 1d10 + 9}). If he reduces the damage to 0, he can catch the missile if it is small enough for him to hold with one hand.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The albino cave spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the albino cave spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The albino cave spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d3 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw and on failure taking 1 ({@damage 1d3}) poison damage. If the target misses its saving throw by 5 or more, it is {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The giant black widow spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the giant black widow spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The giant black widow spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant black widow spider makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on the {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} until it is cure. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) on a failure. The poison is cured on a success. The target dies if the poison reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the poison is cured.

action.name: Web {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained|PHB} by webbing. As an action, the {@condition restrained|PHB} target can make a {@dc 12} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success.
The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Ghostwalk
entries: As a bonus action, the ghostwalk spider becomes {@condition invisible|PHB} and intangible. Attacking doesn't end this invisibility. While {@condition invisible|PHB}, the ghostwalk spider has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and gains the following: Damage Resistances acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons Condition Immunities {@condition paralyzed|PHB}, {@condition petrified|PHB}, {@condition prone|PHB}, {@condition restrained|PHB}, {@condition stunned|PHB} The ghostwalk ends when the spider chooses to end it as a bonus action or when the spider dies.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement (During Ghostwalk Only)
entries: The ghostwalk spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ghostwalk spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The ghostwalk spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghostwalk spider makes two bite attacks. It can make a ghostly snare attack in place of one of its bites.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, or half poison damage with a successful {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but {@condition poisoned|PHB} and {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. While using Ghostwalk, the spider's bite and poison do half damage to targets that aren't affected by Ghostly Snare (see below).

action.name: Ghostly Snare (During Ghostwalk Only, Recharge 5-6)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained|PHB} by ghostly webbing. While {@condition restrained|PHB} in this way, the target is {@condition invisible|PHB} to all creatures except ghostwalk spiders, and it has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. A creature {@condition restrained|PHB} by Ghostly Snare can escape by using an action to make a successful {@dc 14} Strength check, or the webs can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5).

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The spider of Leng's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Eldritch Understanding
entries: A spider of Leng can read and use any scroll.

trait.name: Poisonous Blood
entries: An attacker who hits a spider of Leng with a melee attack from within 5 feet must make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned|PHB} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Shocking Riposte
entries: When a spider of Leng casts {@spell shield|PHB}, it can also make a shocking grasp attack for 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage against one enemy within 5 feet as part of the same reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider of Leng makes two claw attacks, two staff attacks, or one of each.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) poison damage, and the target must make a successful {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} and {@condition blinded|PHB} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Staff of Leng
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage, and the target must make a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the start of the spider's next turn.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The Spiker has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by him.

trait.name: Spiked Armor
entries: The Spiker wears viciously spiked armor. As a bonus action, he can make a melee attack with his spiked armor against a target within 5 feet of him. The spikes deal 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage, and the Spiker's Strength modi er is used on the attack and damage rolls. Additionally, when grappling a creature, the Spiker's armor deals 3 piercing damage to the creature if the grappling attempt succeeds.

trait.name: Spiker's Curse
entries: The character that deals the killing blow to the Spiker must immediately succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be cursed, becoming the new Spiker. This effect can only be reversed by a {@spell wish|PHB} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Spiker makes two attacks: one with his heavy hammer and one with his 3-foot iron spike.

action.name: Heavy Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 3-Foot Iron Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spiker's Gaze
entries: The Spiker targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the Spiker, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become enthralled and walk to the nearest walk or stable surface and stand there until the end of the Spiker's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition paralyzed|PHB} upon reaching the wall for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Spiker's Gaze for the next 24 hours.

resist.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

headerEntries: The spirit oni's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Mask Symbiosis
entries: A willing Small or Medium creature can wear the spirit oni as a mask. While wearing the mask, the creature sees through the spirit oni's eyes and speaks through its mouth, and has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks. The spirit oni cannot act independently while being worn as a mask.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Bite

action.name: Gore

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The statue of wishes can cast magic missile using a 5th level spell slot at will without requiring material components.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The statue of wishes is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The statue of wishes has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The statue of wishes regains 1 hit points at the beginning of each of its turns. If the Statue is dropped to 0 hit points, it will continue to regenerate hit points, returning to full function once its hit points have been fully regained.

action.name: Grant Wish (2/Day)
entries: The statue of wishes is capable of granting two requests to any one creature placed in the circle in front of it. Firstly, it can grant an experience bonus to the target, giving the character enough experience to reach the next level. Secondly, the statue of wishes can cast the {@spell raise dead|PHB} spell on the target inside the circle without requiring material components.

However, each time a request is made, either to raise dead on a creature in the circle or grant bonus experience, roll {@dice 1d100}. On the result of a 20 or less, or if the request is for anything other than reawakening or experience, the Statue of Wishes decides that the creature inside the circle does not receive a wish. In this case, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed saving throw, that creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and is pulled into the statue of wishes' open mouth. The mouth then closes.

A creature who is trapped inside the statue of wishes can survive for up to {@dice 1d6} hours on the available air inside. Rescuing a creature inside requires killing the statue, as the mouth cannot be pried open while it is alive.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The large stingray can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The large stingray has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The large stingray makes two attacks: one with its sting and one with its wing.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

action.name: Wing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The medium stingray can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The medium stingray has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The small stingray can breathe only underwater.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The small stingray has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stone roper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The stone roper can have up to six tendrils at a time.

Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Strength check against it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The stone roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Stony Hide
entries: The stone roper's tough hide is resistant to nonmagical damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone roper makes four attacks with its tendrils, uses Reel, and makes one attack with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 15}).
Until the grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB} and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the roper can't use the same tendril on another target.

action.name: Reel
entries: The roper pulls each creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

action.name: Petrifying Venom (3/Day)
entries: The stone roper can release a petrifying through its tendrils. A creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by the stone roper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone. The creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming {@condition petrified|PHB} on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell greater restoration|PHB} spell or other magic.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The bone swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Shred
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The stirge swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 6d4 + 4}) piercing damage, and the some stirges attache to the target.
While attached, the stirges don't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the stirge's turns, the target loses 19 ({@dice 6d4 + 4}) hit points due to blood loss.
The stirge swarm can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after it drains 10 hit points of blood from the target or the target dies.
A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the stirge swarm.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The undead hummingbird swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Pierce
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 piercing damage. If the target is a creature, the wound bleeds for 1 necrotic damage on each subsequent turn. The wound continues to bleed until it is cured by magical healing.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Swoana immediately goes berserk and gains advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls, but all attack rolls against her have advantage.
This effect lasts until she is slain or combat ends.

trait.name: Blood Starvation
entries: Swoana has been imprisoned within this room and his crypt for almost three centuries, deprived of bloody sustenance for the entirety of her imprisonment. Her Legendary Resistance and Regeneration traits are limited until she feeds.

trait.name: Bound by Death
entries: The ward placed by Bofred binds Swoana to the immediate vicinity of this room and to her crypt. If her corporeal form is slain, she reappears in a comatose state within her crypt.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If Swoana isn't in sunlight or running water, she can use her action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into her true form.

While in bat form, Swoana can't speak, her walking speed is 5 feet, and she has a flying speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

While in mist form, Swoana can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. She is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and she can't pass through water.
She has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage she takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Once Swoana feeds she can then choose to succeed on a saving throw that she has failed.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Swoana regenerates 10 hit points (until she feeds at which point she regenerates 20 hit points) at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Swoana can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Swoana has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Swoana can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: Swoana takes 20 acid damage if she ends her turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Swoana's heart while she is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in her resting place, she is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: Swoana takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Swoana makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claws (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by Swoana, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Swoana's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: Swoana targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see her, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed|PHB} by the vampire. The {@condition charmed|PHB} target regards Swoana as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected.

Although the target isn't under Swoana's control, it takes her requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Swoana's bite attack. Each time Swoana or her companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Swoana is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: Swoana magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Swoana can call {@dice 3d6} wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as her allies and obeying her spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Swoana dies, or until she dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The vampire moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: Swoana makes one greatsword attack.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Swoana makes one bite attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The syanngg has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The syanngg can make up to 4 bite attacks and fire 3 eye rays.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The syanngg shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random from the table below (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it.

entries.name: Syanngg Eye Rays
rows: Slowing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Lightning Bolt. A lightning bolt arcs from the syanngg's eye, forming a 5-foot-wide line that is 120 feet long. Each creature in this area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
Antimagic Ray. The syanngg's eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 120 foot cone.

Petrification Ray. The targeted creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

entries: The target can't take reactions until the end of the tsathar's next turn.
