entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned|PHB} until the end of the tsathar's next turn.

reaction.name: Deflect Missiles
entries: If the tsathar monk has one hand free, it can use its reaction in response to being hit with a ranged weapon attack. It reduces the damage by 14 ({@dice 1d10 + 9}). If it reduces the damage to 0, it can catch the missile if it is small enough for it to hold with one hand.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The tsathar priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tsathar priest can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tsathar priest has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Slimy
entries: Tsathar continuously cover themselves with muck and slime.
Creatures attempting to grapple a tsathar does so with disadvantage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The tsathar priest's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Fetid Shroud of the Frog God
entries: The tsathar priest of Tsathogga is surrounded by a fetid, swirling shroud of foul corruption. At the start of each of the priest's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. A creature that touches the priest or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Fetid Strike
entries: Once on each of the tsathar priest's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, it can cause the attack to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage to the target.

action.name: Kukri
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become the living host to a tsathar egg, which over the course of the egg maturing, migrates to the chest cavity of the host. The host creature must make another {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw after 24 hours of the egg having been implanted. A failed saving throw results in the host becoming violently ill, followed by a deep comalike state that lasts {@dice 2d6 + 2} days. At the end of each day, the host can attempt another saving throw with a success indicating that its body has managed to destroy the egg through normal immune response. At the end of the incubation period, the host awakes to excruciating pain as the young tsathar, freed from its egg, tears its way out of the host, who is reduced to 0 hit points in the process.

A {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check can be attempted to surgically extract an egg from the host. A {@spell lesser restoration|PHB} spell will also cure the condition and purge the host of the egg.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The tsathar sorcerer is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The tsathar sorcerer can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The tsathar sorcerer has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Slimy
entries: Tsathar continuously cover themselves with muck and slime.
Creatures attempting to grapple a tsathar do so with disadvantage.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The tsathar sorcerer's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become the living host to a tsathar egg, which over the course of the egg maturing, migrates to the chest cavity of the host. The host creature must make another {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw after 24 hours of the egg having been implanted. A failed saving throw results in the host becoming violently ill, followed by a deep comalike state that lasts {@dice 2d6 + 2} days. At the end of each day, the host can attempt another saving throw with a success indicating that its body has managed to destroy the egg through normal immune response. At the end of the incubation period, the host awakes to excruciating pain as the young tsathar, freed from its egg, tears its way out of the host, who is reduced to 0 hit points in the process.

A {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check can be attempted to surgically extract an egg from the host. A {@spell lesser restoration|PHB} spell will also cure the condition and purge the host of the egg.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make the melee attack.

trait.name: Rend Armor
entries: When the tunnel worm hits a creature wearing nonmagical armor or carrying a shield with its bite attack, the armor or shield takes a permanent-1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to +0 bonus is destroyed. A damaged shield or suit of armor can be repaired by a blacksmith.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 16}).
Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB}. The tunnel worm can bite only the {@condition grappled|PHB} creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Turane is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: Melee or ranged attack: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ubar is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spells:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The underpriest of Orcus is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Abyssal Blessing of Orcus
entries: The underpriest of Orcus gains 10 temporary hit points when it reduces a hostile creature that is not undead to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Deadsight
entries: The most blessed of Orcus are gifted with truesight.

trait.name: Unholy Strike
entries: Once on each of the underpriest's turns when it hits a creature with a weapon attack, the priest can cause the attack to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage to the target.

trait.name: Unholy Weapon
entries: Orcus bolsters his follower's strikes in battle, imbuing their weapons with the ability to paralyze a foe (included in the attack). In the hands of any but a true follower of Orcus, an unholy weapon loses its power to paralyze a foe.

action.name: Unholy Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed|PHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Caress of Orcus (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from the corpse in 24 hours under the underpriest's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The underpriest can have no more than three shadows under its control at one time.

trait.name: Extreme Resilience
entries: Urovok is immune to all non-magical diseases and has advantage on saving throws against poisons. Additionally, Urovok is not subject to the {@condition exhaustion|PHB} effects of temperature extremes.

trait.name: Four-Armed
entries: Roachfolk possess two middle limbs and two smaller upper limbs. As a bonus action, when it makes a successful melee attack against a target, Urovok can attempt to grapple its foe.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: Urovok deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Urovok that isn't incapacitated and Urovok doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Urovok can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
Sure-footed. Urovok is able to use its extra limbs to assist with balance.
It has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone|PHB}.

trait.name: Winged
entries: Urovok has undersized wings tucked beneath its back carapace.
It gains a fly speed of 40 feet but is not able to hover. It must land at the end of any round in which it fiies or fall, taking {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it falls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Urovok makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The valkyrie's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Asgardian Weapons
entries: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, it does an extra 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage (included in attacks listed below).

trait.name: Cloak of Doom
entries: Any living creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of a valkyrie senses her unsettling presence and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition frightened|PHB} for {@dice 1d4} rounds. Those who succeed are immune to the effect for 24 hours. The valkyrie can suppress this aura at will.

trait.name: Gift of Tongues
entries: Valkyries become fluent in any language they hear spoken for at least 1 minute, and they retain this knowledge forever.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage.

legendary.name: Cast a Cantrip
entries: The valkyrie casts one spell from her at will list.

legendary.name: Spear or Longsword Attack
entries: The valkyrie makes one longsword or spear attack.

legendary.name: Harvest the Fallen (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: A valkyrie can take the soul of a newly dead body and bind it into a weapon or shield. Only one soul can be bound to any object. Individuals whose souls are bound can't be raised by any means short of a wish or comparable magic. A valkyrie can likewise release any soul that has been bound by another valkyrie, or transfer a bound soul from one object to another. Once bound, the soul grants the item a +1 bonus for every 4 character levels of the soul (maximum of +3), and this replaces any other magic on the item. At the DM's discretion, part of this bonus can become an appropriate special quality (a fire giant's soul might create a flaming weapon, for example).

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the vampire warlord isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire warlord can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire warlord can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire warlord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire warlord transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition unconscious|PHB}, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire warlord regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water.
If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire warlord can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire warlord has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated|PHB} in its resting place, the vampire is {@condition paralyzed|PHB} until the stake is removed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: The vampire warlord makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Maul (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature that is {@condition grappled|PHB} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, or {@condition restrained|PHB}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire warlord regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: The vampire warlord targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed|PHB} by the vampire. The {@condition charmed|PHB} target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack. Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire warlord is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Malevolent Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: The vampire warlord magically calls {@dice 4d4} swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call {@dice 3d6} worgs instead. The called creatures arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The vampire warlord moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Melee Attack
entries: The vampire warlord makes one with its maul.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire warlord makes one bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Vertek's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). Vertek can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: Vertek has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed|PHB}, and magic can't put him to sleep.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, Vertek has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During his first turn, Vertek has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Vertek scores against a {@status surprised|PHB} creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Vertek is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Vertek deals an extra 17 ({@damage 5d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of his that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and Vertek doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vertek makes three melee attacks: two with his rapier and one with his whip.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) piercing damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Barbed Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: +1 Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 7}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned|PHB} for 1 hour. If the creature fails the saving throw by 5 or more, the creature is also {@condition unconscious|PHB} while {@condition poisoned|PHB} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

trait.name: Martial Advantage
entries: Once per turn, War Leader Jang can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of War Leader Jang that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: War Leader Jang makes two melee attacks.

action.name: +1 Halberd
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the water weird has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised|PHB}.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the water weird surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Water Invisibility
entries: The water weird is completely {@condition invisible|PHB} while fully submerged in water.

trait.name: Water Bound
entries: If the pool to which it is bound is destroyed, or the water weird leaves the pool, it dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The water weird makes two attacks: one slam attack and one to constrict.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled|PHB} (escape {@dc 14}) and pulled 10 feet toward the water weird. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained|PHB}, the water weird tries to drown it, and the water weird can't constrict another target.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a bonus action, Brayce can move up to his speed toward a hostile creature that he can see.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of his turns, Brayce can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If Brayce is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Once per turn, Brayce deals an extra 17 ({@damage 5d6}) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of his that isn't {@condition incapacitated|PHB} and Brayce doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Brayce makes three melee attacks: two with his shortsword and one with his dagger.

action.name: +1 Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: +1 Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Evasion

trait.name: Sneak Attack

action.name: +1 Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Luug hits with it (included in the attack).

trait.name: Reckless

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Longbow

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Mamma Agga is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 16}, {@hit 8} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Black Aura
entries: Any creature hostile to Mamma Agga that starts its turn within 20 feet of her must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw, unless Agga is {@condition incapacitated|PHB}. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened|PHB} until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Agga's Black Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Blessing of the Black Mother
entries: When any creature within 10 feet of Mamma Agga is reduced to 0 hit points, Mamma Agga gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Touch of the Black Mother
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or construct, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or lose 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points as it begins to bleed profusely. A successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, or magical healing, will stop the blood loss.

trait.name: Brutal Critical
entries: Urk can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Urk hits with it (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Urk makes two brutal st attacks.

action.name: Brutal Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock

trait.name: Insanity Gaze
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the barrow wight and the two of them can see each other, the barrow wight can force the creature to make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw if the barrow wight is not {@condition incapacitated|PHB}. On a failed save, the creature is affected by a short term madness effect for 1 minute. Determine the effect from the table below.

entries.name: Barrow Wight Insanity Gaze
rows: The target retreats into its mind and becomes {@condition paralyzed|PHB}. The effect ends if the creature takes any damage.
The creature is {@condition incapacitated|PHB}, and can only scream, laugh, or weep hysterically.
The creature is {@condition frightened|PHB} and must use its actions to flee from the source of its fear.
The creature babbles incoherently and cannot speak normally or cast spells.
The creature must use its action to attack the nearest creature.
The creature hallucinates vividly, incurring disadvantage on all ability checks.
The creature does whatever anyone tells it to do that isn't obviously self-destructive.
The creature experiences an overpowering urge to eat something strange, such as dirt, offal, or slime.

entries: The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. A successful save ends the effect and renders the target immune to the same barrow wight's insanity gaze for 24 hours.

A creature that isn't {@status surprised|PHB} can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the barrow wight until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the barrow wight in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

trait.name: Resurrection Vulnerability

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity

In this form, the worm that walks is Large-sized, can t through any space large enough for a Tiny creature to pass through without squeezing, and can occupy the same space as another creature and vice versa.

If the worm that walks moves more than 5 feet from the {@condition grappled|PHB} creature, the {@condition grappled|PHB} ends. legendary.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Xillin magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of Xillin, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Xillin's next turn.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)

While in whirlwind form, Xillin is immune to all damage, and it can't be {@condition grappled|PHB}, {@condition petrified|PHB}, knocked {@condition prone|PHB}, {@condition restrained|PHB}, or {@condition stunned|PHB}. Equipment worn or carried by Xillin remain in its possession.

entries: This spell is similar to {@spell programmed illusion|PHB} except that it takes place immediately and disappears at the end of the duration. The program must be specified when the spell is cast and cannot be changed.

spell.name: Anima Lock
entries: When you cast this spell, choose any number of doors, windows, gates, etc. within range that you are familiar with. These portals become locked for the duration. They can be opened by casting {@spell dispel magic|PHB} against a spell cast with a 9th level spell slot. They can be opened by a {@spell wish|PHB}. The portals are immune to damage from non-magical weapons, and have an AC of 25 and 200 hit points. For you and any others you designate specifically or generally at the time of casting, the doors are not locked.

spell.name: Conjure Fiend
entries: This spell functions like {@spell conjure celestial|PHB} except that it conjures a fiend instead of a celestial.

spell.name: Destroy Magic
entries: When you cast this spell, choose a point within range. All spells of 3rd level or lower acting within 30 ft. of that point end. For each spell of 4th level or higher acting within that area, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a  successful check, the spell ends. Any common or uncommon magic items in the area automatically lose their magic permanently. The owners of other magic items may attempt a Dexterity saving throw for each item with a  bonus based on item's rarity. A failed saving throw means that item's magic is permanently removed. Legendary items only lose their powers for one hour, and artifacts are not affected by the spell. Items that are not carried or  held make a generic saving throw using only the bonus given below.
You may choose not to affect any spell or magic item within the range.

spell.name: Distance Distortion
entries: In order to cast this spell, you must have an earth elemental present that is not hostile to you. When you cast this spell, the earth elemental modifies the vary weave of reality, effectively either doubling or halving the distance in both directions for the duration of the spell. The area of effect is an up to 100,000 sq. ft. rectangle containing the earth elemental. Thus, a 10 ft. by 40 ft. room could become either 5 ft. by 20 ft. or 20 ft. by 80 ft. The transformation is real, and so is not detectable as an illusion, however, the earth elemental may be detected and somebody using {@spell true seeing|PHB} can tell that the matter has been compressed or stretched.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring your {@status Concentration|PHB}.

spell.name: Grand Curse
entries: As an action, you lay a magnificent curse on the target, who must pass a Wisdom ability saving throw to avoid it. Curses can include losing 6 points from one ability score, disadvantage on attacks or saving throws, or having to succeed on a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of every round of combat or be {@condition stunned|PHB} for one round. It can also take the form of a {@spell geas|PHB} or very strong {@spell suggestion|PHB}.

If used to place a curse on an area, the caster may affect 80 square ft. The nature of the grand curse is decided by the spellcaster upon conclusion of the ritual, which takes 1 hour to complete; any of the above effects may be placed upon the area, and any creature that comes into contact with the area is subject to the curse. The player should be creative with the types of curses enacted, but should be in line with the above descriptions.
The curse can be removed with {@spell greater restoration|PHB} or {@spell wish|PHB}, but not with {@spell remove curse|PHB}.

spell.name: Group Haste
entries: When you cast the spell {@spell Haste|PHB} using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can affect an additional 4 creatures for every 2 spell slots above 3rd.

spell.name: Improved Major Image
entries: This spell functions like {@spell Major Image|PHB} except that its effects are physical as well as visual, like {@spell Phantasmal Force|PHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring your {@status Concentration|PHB}.

spell.name: Mage's Evasion

m.text: a diamond worth 1000 gp, which the spell consumes when triggered

entries: This spell transfers you and everything you carry (except for other creatures or objects that weigh more than 50 pounds) to a destination you designate at the time of casting. When casting mage's evasion, you must specify the locale and detail up to six specific conditions that trigger this spell. When any of these conditions occurs, your body, mind, and soul are transported to the target destination. The location can be any place you very familiar with, as defined by the teleport spell, even on another plane.

When casting the spell, you cast {@spell teleport|PHB} and possibly other spells that take effect when you arrive at your destination point. The initial casting of mage's evasion drains {@dice 1d6} hit points from the spellcaster. These hit points are "stored" in the spell, and may be regained by the caster normally.
The stored hit points are immediately recovered by the caster upon the triggering of the evasion.

The teleport aspect of this spell takes you to your destination, so any condition that prevents teleporting also prevents mage's evasion. Once reaching the destination point, the companion spells included in the evasion instantly and simultaneously take effect. The companion spells must be ones that have a range of self and be of a spell level no higher than one-third of your caster level. The total combined level of companion spells may not exceed your caster level. The conditions you specify to bring the spell into effect must be clear, although they can be general in nature.

The spell pulls together your mind, body, and soul if they have been separated. For example, if your soul is trapped in a {@spell magic jar|PHB} when the evasion is triggered, your soul returns to your body (breaking the {@spell magic jar|PHB} spell). If your body or soul has been bound by an effect that allowed for a saving throw, you are granted an additional saving throw to escape.
You may only use one mage's evasion spell at a time; if a second is cast, the first spell (if still active) is dispelled.

spell.name: Mirage Arcane

components.m: a piece of the actual scene being recreated

entries: When you cast this spell, you cause the area within range to take on the appearance of a region you have previously seen and know well (the quality of the illusion is proportional to your knowledge of the area being recreated; see table below). Creatures within illusion experience the recreated area as if it were real, possibly taking damage from illusory hazards or avoiding damage from real ones while under the illusion. While the illusion can have some movement, such as flowing water, it cannot be controlled actively once created.
entriesHigherLevel: At higher levels. If you cast this spell using a 9th level spell slot, the illusion persists without the need for {@status Concentration|PHB}.

spell.name: Permanent Illusion
entries: When you use an action to cast this spell, you create a permanent illusion on the surface of a material. The illusion may "coat" up to 100 sq. ft of area. The illusion is static and purely visual.

spell.name: Phase Door
entries: When you cast this spell, a section of wall within range up to 20 sq. ft. in area and up to 2 ft. thick is altered such that you and the wall are in opposite phases. Up to six times, you may pass through the wall as if it weren't there. For others, the wall appears and acts as a solid wall. When you walk into the doorway, it appears to others as if you walk into the wall and disappear.

spell.name: Prayer
entries: Creatures of your choice within 30 ft. of a point you can see within range have disadvantage on saving throws while this spell is in effect.

spell.name: Ray of Exhaustion
entries: You send a ray of negative energy at a creature you can see within range. If you hit, the target must attempt a Constitution saving throw. If it fails the saving throw, the creature gains two levels of {@condition exhaustion|PHB}. If it succeeds, it gains one level of {@condition exhaustion|PHB}. The {@condition exhaustion|PHB} can be removed normally through magic or rest.

spell.name: Screen
entries: This spell combines several elements to create a powerful protection from scrying and direct observation. When casting the spell, you dictate what will and will not be observed in the spell's area. The illusion created must be stated in general terms. Once the conditions are set, they cannot be changed. Attempts to scry the area with a {@item crystal ball|DMG} or other magic automatically detect the image stated by you. Sight and sound are appropriate to the illusion created. Direct observation may allow an Intelligence saving throw, if there is cause to disbelieve what is seen. Even entering the area does not cancel the illusion or necessarily allow a saving throw, assuming that hidden beings take care to stay out of the way of those affected by the illusion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can increase the duration of the illusion. If you use an 8th level slot, it lasts for one year, and if you use a 9th level spell slot to cast this spell, it lasts until you dispel it.

spell.name: Sepia Snake Sigil

m.text: powdered amber worth 500 gp and a snake scale

entries: When you cast sepia snake sigil, a small symbol appears in the text of one written work such as a book, scroll, or map. The text containing the symbol must be at least twenty-five words long.

When anyone reads the text containing the symbol, the sepia snake springs into being and strikes the reader, provided there is line of effect between the symbol and the reader. The target can attempt a Dexterity saving throw to evade the snake's strike. If it succeeds, the sepia snake dissipates in a flash of brown light accompanied by a puff of dun-colored smoke and a loud noise. If the target fails its save, it is engulfed in a shimmering amber field of force and immobilized until released, either at your command or when {@dice 1d4} days + one day per level of spell slot used to cast the spell have passed.

While trapped in the amber field of force, the subject does not age, breathe, grow hungry, sleep, or regain spells. It is preserved in a state of suspended animation, unaware of its surroundings. It can be damaged by outside forces (and perhaps even killed), since the field provides no protection against physical injury. However, a dying subject does not make death saves or become stable until the spell ends.
The hidden sigil cannot be detected by normal observation, and detect magic reveals only that the entire text is charged with abjuration magic.
{@spell Dispel magic|PHB} can remove the sigil.

spell.name: Tempus Fugit
entries: When you cast this spell, any creature within the area feels and acts as if time has sped up for them. For every round that passes outside the range of the spell, the creatures inside experience 4 rounds. The creatures can take actions, heal, and so forth at four times the rate of the outside world.
They must also eat, rest, and so forth at four times the rate. A creature that enters the range of the spell while it is in progress experiences the time dilation as well.
entriesHigherLevel: At higher levels. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can increase the duration of the illusion. For each level above 5th, the duration triples so that using a 9th level spell slot, the duration is 81 hours.
